test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(2, 20, 4)

(5, 61, 6)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

(2, 20, 4)

22 + 42 = 20

4 + 16 = 20

20 = 20 (LHS = RHS)

And,

(5, 61, 6)

52 + 62 = 61

25 + 36 = 61

61 = 61 (LHS = RHS)

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) (1, 8, 3)

12 + 32 = 8

1 + 9 = 8

10 ≠ 8 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) (4, 40, 6)

42 + 42 = 40

16 + 36 = 40

42 ≠ 40 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) (7, 45, 2)

72 + 22 = 45

49 + 4 = 45

55 ≠ 45 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4) (3, 25, 4) 

32 + 42 = 25

9 + 16 = 25

25 = 25 (LHS = RHS)

Thus, out of all '(3, 25, 4)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
